title: Stream FIFO
text: Control backpressure between hardware logic and upstream data interface, 3 inputs, 3 outputs; {Depth of FIFO} sets the fIFO depth and {Almost full threshold}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: dValidIn
ports.summary: Indication of valid input stream data Boolean scalar

ports.name: rdyFromDown
ports.summary: Ready signal from downstream interface Boolean scalar

ports.name: dValidOut
ports.summary: Indication of valid output stream data Boolean scalar

ports.name: rdyToUp
ports.summary: Ready signal to upstream interface Boolean scalar

params.name: Depth of FIFO
params.values: FIFO depth 16 (default) | integer greater than or equal to four

params.name: Almost full threshold
params.values: Almost full threshold value 8 (default) | positive integer
